method: Read-only source, artifact and oracle/receipt inspection. No hardware builds or simulations run by reviewer. Relative paths resolve from workspace root. Bindings qualify named module sources only, not whole historical trees.

modules.name: ddr-bridge
modules.verified: Two integrated FIR hashes, all five replay log hashes and saved selected pipeline executable digest match the integrated receipt. Relevant production source hashes match the isolated tested receipt.
modules.coverage: AW/W skew, denied-tail recovery, mixed read/write, reordered R/B responses, reset skew, payload/ID/RLAST negatives; 4 total slots, 2 writes, 16 beats, AXI ID width 4 and TL source width 5.
limits: Current base board proof supplies selected-profile composition, without replacing directed protocol negatives.

geometry_verification.note: Corrects preliminary reviewer misreading of positional parameter 3 as AXI ID width. Emitter and actual FIR independently confirm AXI ID width 4; no such geometry gap exists.

modules.name: coherent-home
modules.verified: 36 retained artifacts from old home receipt match, including emitted FIR and positive/negative logs. Generated C++/headers/executables and some build logs are omitted. Relevant home source and helper hashes match.
modules.coverage: Six home variants include 512 lines, two ways, two acquire owners and 19-bit compact tags across 4GiB; independent data/protocol checks, simultaneous E/C, held upstream, aliases, release recheck and reset. Current cache r2 adds real home/DMA composition.
limits: CacheTagConfig differs only by trailing bankedStorage option. Home reads geometry/compact only; those definitions are unchanged. This is source-delta reasoning, not whole-file hash identity.
Old omitted binaries cannot be reused from the archive.

modules.name: integer-prf
modules.verified: All 65 archive-manifest artifacts match. Leaf, test wrapper and independent host oracle hashes match current source. Original and sampled synchronous-reset normalized SV are byte-identical.
modules.coverage: 48/64/128-entry matrix with 16,522/16,682/17,386 data checks, lane collision priority, x0, disabled poison, 25 resets per depth, and seven negative controls.
limits: Historical unit fixture has four read ports, not the entire selected native observer/read-port census. Current source has a parametric per-port loop; selected CPU/core/board composition was separately checked.
Reset lowering is explicitly test-only; raw original GSIM failure is preserved.
No current mapped resource or timing claim.

modules.name: rob-payload
modules.verified: Leaf and relevant helper source hashes match. Both embedded positive ledger logs reproduce the archived SHA256 for the missing separate test.log files. Twelve retained archive artifacts match; eleven listed old log files are omitted.
modules.coverage: Register/banked pair: three seeds, 18,000 random cycles, 1,067 allocations, 778 commits, 339 dual commits, 58 recoveries and 17,892 rejected completions; payload negative recorded.
limits: Historical focused ledger uses tagBits=8. Current CPU/core/board proofs supply full 64-bit token integration.
Separate old model artifacts and individual ledger negative log files were omitted; no fresh replay was performed.
No mapped resource or timing claim.

modules.name: translation-protection
modules.verified: All five reused preparation/store-buffer/adapter model FIR hashes and model object hashes match. Relevant production sources and VirtualLoadPrecheckGsim wrapper match.
modules.coverage: Preparation cancellation/full-token checks, store alias blocking, actual DTLB+adapter with enabled/disabled and identity-flow variants, permission/range/epoch/backpressure negative oracles.
limits: Historical decoded-backend composition has an older IntegerBackend. It does not qualify current enabled-precheck backend ownership/cancellation.
Current serial base board VM proof has zero cancellationWhileOutstanding witness. The separately queued enabled-precheck integration gate must witness real outstanding cancellation.
No model executable was run by this review.

modules.name: network-dma
modules.verified: All 32 retained network receipt/log artifacts match their archive hashes. All six positive summaries and negative anchors match actual retained logs. DMA, queue, config and packet/queue host harness hashes match current source.
modules.coverage: packet-tx4: four RX slots, four memory credits, 2GiB aperture, four posted TX slots; six wrap batches, held-read/held-stream STOP, posted memory fault, simultaneous RX and legacy restart. coherent-tx4: real512 directory, dirty source probes, RX invalidation and retained FIFO completion.
limits: Old emitted FIR and executable hashes are recorded but their files were omitted from the delivered archive. Do not claim fresh replay.
EthernetPort.scala now has appended tri-speed types/options; EthernetFrameBeat used by the packet interface is unchanged. This is source-delta reasoning.

New two-bank MAC 56-case DMA suite checks two posted batches/retained completion, but its faults are legacy-doorbell cases, not posted STOP/error coverage. MAC owner is preparing a fresh focused packet-tx4 check.
Native independent clocks, physical CDC, board and PPA are unqualified.

overall: All six inherited leaf implementations have source-matched historical proof. Retained-artifact and profile limits remain explicit; new integration gates should target changed composition and missing replayability.
